text:
mei_eval: quick heads-up: polyphony-v0.3 int6 bring-up shows consistent loss on ja->zh detok where ruby (furigana) markers are removed from decodes. repro on staging. :frowning:

ravi: numbers? small sample ok?

mei_eval: baseline fp16 ja->zh BLEU=31.0, int6 BLEU=25.8 (delta -5.2). detok roundtrip mismatch for ~18% of samples. example input: '\u6f22\u5b57\u3000\uFF08\u304b\u3093\u3058\uFF09' (kanji + fullwidth paren + furigana) -> decoded loses the paren group.

nora_token: int6 shouldn't change tokenizer assets. did the package include different tokenizers?

infra-bot: deploy log excerpt:
```
[2026-06-12T09:12:01Z] requested quant=int6_v1
[2026-06-12T09:12:02Z] kernel-compat: quant kernel incompatible -> fallback to soft_token_table_v0
[2026-06-12T09:12:03Z] tokenizer: loaded /opt/token_tables/soft_token_table_v0.tbl
```

mei_eval: that explains it. soft_token_table_v0 collapses bracketed ruby groups.

ravi: plan: 1) force canary to use explicit token_table=polyphony_v2.tbl; 2) run int8/q8x2 to compare sensitivity; 3) add CI detok roundtrip for ja/zh.

nora_token: will patch wheel metadata to pin token_table and add a pre-deploy check that kernel fallback does NOT swap token tables. opening PR now.

eval-bot: automated triage: signature matches furigana-detok-loss pattern, similarity=0.76. severity=P3 for now (release hold).

mei_eval: thanks team. i'll hold rollouts until canary confirms restored BLEU. attaching minimal repro: ```from tokenizers import Tokenizer\nt=Tokenizer.from_file('tokenizers/polyphony_v0.3.json')\nprint(t.encode('\u6f22\u5b57\uFF08\u304b\u3093\u3058\uFF09').tokens)```

ravi: thanks, will update when canary re-run completes.
